verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm only that Teams offers meetings and calling. Screen sharing is implied solely by community reports: users describe a presenter's desktop being shared with annotation on top, and a screen-sharing button that is disabled on Firefox ESR in the browser client. missing for 10: first-party documentation of screen sharing in calls, evidence of live-collaboration controls (e.g. giving control), and evidence of reliable cross-browser support.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can share my screen during a call for live collaboration

citations.quote: Microsoft Teams delivers chat-based collaboration, meetings, calling, and enterprise voice features.
It essentially takes a screenshot of the presenters desktop and then starts a whiteboard session.
